# Project-data-only evidence policy

## Current user direction — 31 October 2026

Contributor directed: “ok then lets move on to item 5 and not try snapshotting details about the computer anymore. remember that somewhere so we don't accidentally trip this safety alarm again”. This applies to future work and requests for this project.

- Preserve useful **project code, contracts, primary research, synthetic fixture definitions, results, counters and performance measurements** when independently authorized and accepted by the tools. Project-declared dependency revisions are project facts, not a request to inventory the computer.
- **Do not snapshot, inventory, save or transmit computer-environment details.** Do not prepare computer/system/header/toolchain inventories, device or process identities, machine configuration/capacity snapshots, installed-binary surveys or absolute computer paths for evidence packages or requests. Do not collect them merely because they might make a backup more exhaustive.
- Design new project results and reports to contain only necessary project data from the start. Do not include computer-environment snapshots in source/research/checkpoint payloads. Progress logs must not contain secrets or computer inventories.
- This is not permission to weaken in-program correctness/FP checks or ignore any user/tool restriction. Report project outcomes honestly; do not infer a timing, compatibility, resource-containment or acceptance result from a source review.
- Any stopped save and its explicitly held dependent actions remain stopped. Do not retry, omit-and-retry, repackage, reconstruct, use an alternate destination/tool, or silently change a dependency to evade a rejection. A new independently authorized project result is not a completion of a stopped save.

## Current sequence

Contributor explicitly moved from incomplete item3 to item4, and now from incomplete/untested item4 to item5. These are sequencing changes, **not acceptance of items3 or4**. The ten-goal Page and project checkpoints must retain that distinction. Items6–10 remain queued unless Contributor directs otherwise.

This project note records the durable preference; it does not alter global account permissions or authorize any new execution.
